_comment: ghostpkg scanning its own repository. This file is passed explicitly with
--config, because ghostpkg never reads an ignore file from the tree it is
scanning -- an agent with shell access could otherwise write its own
permission slip. That rule is why this sits under .github and is named in
the workflow rather than being found automatically.

ignore.reason: Documentation. Both READMEs use `pip install foo-bar` as the example of a hallucinated name, so ghostpkg is right to flag it -- it is an install command for a package that does not exist. Suppressed rather than reworded because the example is the clearest way to explain what the tool does.
